description: Statics + dynamics decomposed. Free body diagrams, 2D/3D equilibrium, virtual work, friction, rigid body kinematics + kinetics, energy methods, vibrations, dynamic balancing.

sub_mechanisms.name: 2D_equilibrium
sub_mechanisms.definition: ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0, ΣM_z = 0. Three equations; up to three unknowns.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard plane structures. Beams, trusses, frames. Foundation of structural statics.

sub_mechanisms.name: 3D_equilibrium
sub_mechanisms.definition: ΣF_i = 0 for i=x,y,z. ΣM_i = 0 for i=x,y,z. Six equations; up to six unknowns.
sub_mechanisms.why: Spatial structures. More unknowns possible. Vector form: ΣF = 0, ΣM = 0.

sub_mechanisms.name: support_reactions
sub_mechanisms.definition: Pin: 2 reactions (2D), 3 (3D). Roller: 1. Fixed: 3 (2D), 6 (3D). Determine from equilibrium.
sub_mechanisms.why: FBD includes reactions. Static determinacy: unknowns = equations. Indeterminate needs additional methods.

sub_mechanisms.name: Coulomb_friction
sub_mechanisms.definition: F_friction ≤ μN. Static μ_s > kinetic μ_k. Limiting friction at slip.
sub_mechanisms.why: Most common friction model. Belts, brakes, climbing systems. Self-locking when angle < arctan(μ).

sub_mechanisms.name: virtual_work_principle
sub_mechanisms.definition: δW = 0 for system in equilibrium. Sum of virtual works by all forces.
sub_mechanisms.why: Alternative to FBD. Powerful for connected systems. Avoids analysing internal reactions.

sub_mechanisms.name: rigid_body_kinematics_velocity
sub_mechanisms.definition: v_B = v_A + ω × r_AB. Velocity of B from A's velocity + body rotation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Linkage analysis, robotics. Foundation of mechanism design. Instantaneous centre of rotation.

sub_mechanisms.name: rigid_body_kinetics_Newton
sub_mechanisms.definition: ΣF = ma_G (center of mass). ΣM_G = I_G α. Decoupled translation + rotation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard rigid body dynamics. Position of mass centre + rotation about it. Foundation.

sub_mechanisms.name: energy_method_dynamics
sub_mechanisms.definition: T_1 + V_1 + W_nc = T_2 + V_2. Kinetic + potential + non-conservative work.
sub_mechanisms.why: Often simpler than F=ma. Scalar. Useful for connected systems, varying forces. Standard alternative.

sub_mechanisms.name: single_DOF_vibration
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of vibration. Natural freq ω_n = √(k/m). Damping ratio ζ = c/(2√(km)).

sub_mechanisms.name: modal_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: MDOF system: eigenvalue problem M⁻¹K. Natural frequencies + mode shapes.
sub_mechanisms.why: Building vibration, vehicle NVH, machine resonance. Avoid forcing near natural frequencies. Standard CAE analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: dynamic_balancing
sub_mechanisms.definition: Rotating systems: add masses to cancel out-of-balance. Static + dynamic balance.
sub_mechanisms.why: Engines, turbines, tyres. Imbalance: vibration, bearing wear, noise. Standard manufacturing operation.

sub_mechanisms.name: gyroscopic_effect
sub_mechanisms.definition: Spinning body resists axis change. M = I·ω×Ω.
sub_mechanisms.why: Gyroscopes, motorcycles, aircraft. Stable platform. Critical in high-RPM systems.

derivation_rules.name: FBD_first_step_in_every_problem
derivation_rules.why: Errors in FBD propagate. Identify all forces: applied, weights, reactions. Standard discipline. Engineering instructors insist.

derivation_rules.name: static_determinacy_unknowns_equations
then: statically determinate; solvable by equilibrium alone
derivation_rules.why: More unknowns: indeterminate, need deflection compatibility. Fewer: mechanism. Determinacy = solvability via equilibrium.

derivation_rules.name: energy_methods_simpler_for_complex_systems
then: energy method easier than F=ma per part
derivation_rules.why: F=ma: many vector equations, internal forces. Energy: scalar, internal forces cancel. Lagrangian mechanics formalises.

derivation_rules.name: natural_frequency_at_resonance_amplifies
derivation_rules.why: Damping limited. Bridge collapse (Tacoma Narrows), washing machine wobble. Avoid by design: shift natural freq, add damping.

derivation_rules.name: balancing_critical_high_RPM
derivation_rules.why: Imbalance force = mω²r. ω² makes high RPM critical. Even small imbalance = large force. Engines, turbines must be balanced.
